header_notes: Layout from the ctor's 11 vptr stores, the vtable blob and the thunk names: CAttributeHandler at 0; vptr-bearing subobjects at 0x18, 0x1C, 0x30 (RetClass/IsA), 0x38, 0x120, 0x250, 0x294, 0x420, 0x510, 0x870; cFlocket fields from 0x970 (Vec3 16-aligned; flight time 0x980; hint Vec3 0x990; vert/horiz acc 0x9A0/0x9A4; light ptr 0x9A8), size 0x9B0. Prototype: 0x320 base + char light id + 14 floats, size 0x360. Primary vtable has 375 slots (filler virtuals Slot12..Slot374 in the stand-in). All of that matches the compiler-made thunks by mangled name.
split_notes: Belongs: F24-F32, F33-F42 (logic; F33-F36, F39, F40 not matched), F43-F45, thunks F47-F57, registrar F77/F78. Not: F01-F22 (other classes: cSticklerGrenade, cBulletData ...), F23 and F46 (other accessors), F58-F76 (cHarpoonBolt and base-class vtable entries F72-F76). F24/F25 (RetClass/IsA) sit before MakeNew in the object file; F47/F52/F54/F57 thunks reach them from the later tables.
